summary: Running `make test` or `scripts/ci.py test` from the repository root rewrote the gitignored ./.device (device key and refresh token) and ./tachikoma.log, because eight test modules construct Device() and five import run.py, and both write relative to the working directory (SPEC-02).  - scripts/ci.py run_tests runs every suite with a fresh temporary directory as   the working directory, restores the previous cwd afterwards and closes root   log files opened inside it so the directory can be removed on Windows too. - Makefile test and test-security keep their names but run from `mktemp -d`   (removed by trap) with an absolute interpreter: $(CURDIR)/.venv/bin/python   when executable, else `command -v python3`; PYTHON=... is made absolute. - tests/__init__.py refuses `python -m unittest tests.<module>` from the repo   root while ./.device exists, naming the safe command, and documents the   unsafe forms it covers only partly (discover -s tests, test file as script). - test_pvp_sanitized_inputs locates the repository from its own file path.  Regression tests in tests/test_ci.py build a scratch repository copy with sentinel .device and tachikoma.log and prove they stay byte-identical with the same mtime after scripts/ci.py test, make test and make test-security, that the temporary directory is removed, that the guard refuses, and that `make -n test` shows an absolute interpreter. Suite: 952 tests (945 + 7), 1 skip.  Implements S02-R1..R6. Implemented by the SPEC-02 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite its requirement ids; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
